headline: Bangladesh Premier League Won't Happen Due to Financial Crisis; Board Says It Lost 400 Million Taka in Last Two Seasons
summary: AVIC Science & Technology's first-half profit attributable to shareholders fell 20.1% to RMB 820 million. Revenue rose only 0.9%, with earnings per share of RMB 0.103.
why: AVIC Science & Technology is a Chinese aviation-related technology company listed in Hong Kong, and its results reflect profitability in China's aerospace supply chain.
